user.title: Vigia wildfire watch
user.description: Fire risk and warnings come from IPMA, incidents from fogos.pt. fogos.pt asks each user for their own free API key (request one at fogos.pt/en/api); without it Vigia polls gently and may be rate limited. Add a free NASA FIRMS map key (firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/api/map_key) to include satellite hotspots. Home comes from Home Assistant unless you set a latitude and longitude.
